# Handyeco - Edinburgh Handyman Services (Comprehensive Guide)

> Complete business profile, service descriptions, technical capabilities, pricing, and Edinburgh service coverage for Handyeco.

## About Handyeco
Handyeco is a premier Edinburgh-based property maintenance and handyman service operated by Ekrem Guran. We serve homeowners, tenants, landlords, and letting agencies across the City of Edinburgh and surrounding Lothians.

## Core Services

### 1. Flat-Pack Furniture Assembly
- Specialization in IKEA systems: PAX wardrobes, HEMNES, MALM, BESTÅ, KALLAX, and PLATSA.
- Also assembly for Next Home, Wayfair, John Lewis, Argos, and Dunelm.
- Safe wall anchoring into stone and plasterboard.

### 2. TV Wall Mounting & Heavy Hanging
- Screen sizes from 32 inches to 85+ inches (Samsung, LG OLED, Sony Bravia).
- Secure installation into historic Edinburgh stone tenement walls using heavy-duty Fischer DuoPower anchors and masonry drill bits.
- Flush, tilt, and full-motion articulating cantilever bracket installations.
- Heavy Victorian ornate mirrors, floating shelves, curtain poles, and radiator covers.

### 3. Silicone Mastic Sealing & Bath/Shower Resealing
- Complete excision of black mildew-stained or failed silicone.
- Anti-fungal sanitization of joints.
- Application of premium sanitary grade silicone (BT1 / Dow Corning) with flawless tooling.

### 4. Painting, Decorating & Patch Repairs
- Skirting boards, architraves, doors, interior walls, and water stain covering.
- Tenement door trimming after new carpet installations.

## Service Coverage Areas
- Edinburgh City Centre (EH1, EH2, EH3)
- Southside, Newington, Marchmont, Morningside, Bruntsfield (EH8, EH9, EH10)
- Leith, Newhaven, Trinity, Stockbridge (EH4, EH5, EH6)
- Portobello, Duddingston, Craigmillar, Liberton (EH7, EH15, EH16)
- Colinton, Corstorphine, Murrayfield, Cramond (EH12, EH13, EH14)
- Musselburgh (EH21), Dalkeith (EH22), Livingston (EH54), South Queensferry (EH30)
